html:
Unique Research · Recap · July 22, 2024

On July 18, the AIGC Application Business Summit — hosted by Geili Message (给力讯息), co-organized by Unique Research, Waveform Intelligence (波形智能), TTC, and Weihua Tech (未画科技) — convened at Shanghai Pudong Software Park. The event aimed to build the AIGC ecosystem and cross-industry exchange; more than 1,200 AIGC enthusiasts and professionals attended.

H1 China AIGC business report

Unique Research and Geili Message jointly released the H1 2024 China AIGC Industry Business Report, covering large-model adoption by industry. H1 2024: 207 LLM-related wins (+53% YoY), total value ¥568M (level with full-year 2023). Top bidding industries by amount: finance, telecom operators, TMT.

Morning keynotes

Wei Wei, Minimax commercial partner — “Development and use cases of general LLMs” across workplace, education, customer service, and search.

Li Guo, Fancytech founder & CEO — “Generative AI replacing basic shooting”; Deep Video model for consumer-scene AIGC; brand marketing & content; AI raises efficiency rather than replacing people.

Chen Xiaojian, AWS product GM — “Underlying GenAI capabilities and scenarios”; AWS compute services for rising industry demand.

Roundtable

Unique Research founder Wu Wei; Geili Message founder & CEO Hua Kun; Waveform Intelligence founder & CEO Jiang Yuchen; TTC co-founder & CTO Ning Liaoyuan; auto digital-tech lead Wu Jian; and Lanma Tech founder & CEO Zhou Jian (Unique Partner, appearing as event guest) discussed “AIGC commercialization in enterprise use and innovation” — founding paths, efficiency, and growth.

Afternoon expo & tracks

Main hall became a startup expo: 30 AIGC companies showed text, image, video, agents, digital humans, pharma AI, and more.

LLM commercialization cases: Weisi Tech, AiPPT, UCloud, Real Intelligence (实在智能), Futuresmart AI, Yunxiang Wisdom, Waveform Intelligence, and others.

AIGC product PMF: Quanzhentong (全诊通), Niren AI (拟仁智能), Oupai Cloud, Songying Tech, Monkey Infinite, Ximalaya, and others — technical progress and landing lessons.

The summit closed with energy for everyday AIGC applications ahead.

— END —
